reader.notes: Native ORD-MAX renders to OrdMaxExact (exact values, SelectExact) or OrdMaxAt/OrdMax via ExtremeIndex; all keep the first index and replace only on strictly greater. Identical output at --std 2023. Observation (not a conformance defect): CobolIntrinsics.ExactValue.cs#SelectExact re-writes the leftmost-strict-update loop beside the unified ExtremeIndex kernel (PB2635 unified the other carriers); the exact lane is what native ORD-MAX/ORD-MIN/MAX/MIN take.
